name: modelclash-monorepo
description: modelclash — compare responses from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google models side-by-side

scripts.build: npm run build -w @modelclash/core && npm run build -w modelclash

howToRun.runCli: npm run cli -- <command> [options]   # runs built CLI (requires `npm run build` first)
howToRun.runCliDev: npm run cli:dev -- <command> [options]   # runs CLI from TypeScript source, no build step
examples: npm run cli -- compare "Write a haiku about the sea"
